nodes.label: graphify Skill Trigger
nodes.rationale: Project-scoped instruction that the /graphify trigger must resolve to the installed skill at .claude/skills/graphify/SKILL.md before any other handling.

nodes.label: graphify Knowledge Graph Usage Policy
nodes.rationale: For codebase questions run graphify query first when graphify-out/graph.json exists - a scoped subgraph is usually far smaller than GRAPH_REPORT.md or raw grep. Read GRAPH_REPORT.md only for broad architecture review, and run graphify update . after modifying code (AST-only, no API cost).

nodes.label: Plugin config.yaml Glob Import of twig_hooks
nodes.norm_label: plugin config.yaml glob import of twig_hooks
nodes.rationale: The plugin's whole configuration is a single glob import of twig_hooks/**/*.yaml, so any file dropped into config/twig_hooks/ is loaded automatically - and deleting that directory without editing this import is exactly the breakage CLEANUP_GUIDE.md warns about.

nodes.label: Plugin Admin Routing Placeholder
nodes.rationale: Comment-only file kept so the test application's routes.yaml resource import still resolves; removing it would break the import rather than simply define nothing.

nodes.label: Shop Twig Hooks Placeholder
nodes.rationale: Entirely commented out, but it must exist as a real file because config/config.yaml globs this directory. The commented template shows the intended shape: a sylius_twig_hooks.hooks entry with a template under the @JpmMartinSyliusShippingCarriersPlugin namespace and a priority.

nodes.label: TestApplication Doctrine Entity Mapping
nodes.rationale: A non-bundle, attribute-driven mapping over tests/TestApplication/src/Entity under the prefix Tests\JpmMartin\SyliusShippingCarriersPlugin - the mechanism by which entity-extension fixtures are exercised. Annotated 'remove if you do not need to extend entities'.

nodes.label: Test App Imports the Plugin's config.yaml
nodes.norm_label: test app imports the plugin's config.yaml
nodes.rationale: resource '@JpmMartinSyliusShippingCarriersPlugin/config/config.yaml' - the bundle-namespace import that makes the plugin's own configuration (and through it the twig_hooks glob) reach the running kernel.

nodes.label: Test App Admin Route Import
nodes.rationale: Key jpm_martin_sylius_shipping_carriers_admin importing '@JpmMartinSyliusShippingCarriersPlugin/config/routes/admin.yaml'; both the key prefix and the bundle namespace encode the plugin identity set by the rename.

nodes.label: Plugin Architecture Overview
nodes.rationale: jpmmartin/sylius-shipping-carriers-plugin delivers UPS and FedEx shipping for Sylius - real-time rates, labels, tracking and customs. It began as the Sylius plugin skeleton, so skeleton scaffolding still coexists with the plugin's own code.

nodes.label: JpmMartinSyliusShippingCarriersExtension and Configuration
nodes.rationale: src/DependencyInjection/JpmMartinSyliusShippingCarriersExtension.php with src/DependencyInjection/Configuration.php; services live in config/services.xml plus an empty config/services/.

nodes.label: JpmMartinSyliusShippingCarriersPlugin (Main Plugin Class)
nodes.rationale: src/JpmMartinSyliusShippingCarriersPlugin.php, the bundle entry point using SyliusPluginTrait.

nodes.label: PSR-4 Namespace Mapping
nodes.rationale: JpmMartin\SyliusShippingCarriersPlugin\ maps to src/; Tests\JpmMartin\SyliusShippingCarriersPlugin\ maps to both tests/ and tests/TestApplication/src/.

nodes.label: No config/twig_hooks/admin.yaml
nodes.rationale: Only shop.yaml exists under config/twig_hooks/, recorded because the skeleton guides assume an admin counterpart is present.

nodes.label: Step 4: Cleanup Checklist
nodes.rationale: Three-part tick list: delete files, clean configurations, then additional cleanup (empty directories, unused composer/npm dependencies, cache clear).

nodes.label: Step 3: Configuration to Clean
nodes.rationale: services.xml definitions, config/routes/*.yaml, config/twig_hooks/*.yaml, assets entrypoint imports, config/config.yaml imports that reference deleted directories, and Behat suites.yml - deleting files without these leaves the container referencing missing classes.

nodes.label: Step 2: Files to Delete
nodes.rationale: Example controllers, assets/*/js entry scripts, whole template directories, *_example/*_demo feature files, and Behat ExampleContext / Example*Page classes.

nodes.label: Step 1: Grep for greeting/example/demo
nodes.rationale: Recursive grep restricted to php/js/yml/yaml/xml/twig, so identification precedes deletion rather than following it.

nodes.label: Cross-Version Troubleshooting
nodes.rationale: Three failure modes: service ids that changed between versions, namespace ambiguity (use FQCNs), and dependency conflicts debugged with composer why-not.

nodes.label: sylius_shop.checkout.select_shipping.content Hook
nodes.rationale: The checkout shipping-selection hook named in the commented example - the natural insertion point for carrier rate presentation in a UPS/FedEx plugin, and the only concrete Sylius UI extension point named anywhere in this configuration set.

nodes.label: bundles.php Registration
nodes.rationale: tests/TestApplication/config/bundles.php must name the renamed class, otherwise the plugin silently never registers in the test application.

nodes.label: composer.json Package Metadata and PSR-4 Mappings
nodes.norm_label: composer.json package metadata and psr-4 mappings
nodes.rationale: kebab-case name, a real description, type sylius-plugin, autoload {CompanyName}\{PluginName}\ to src/ and autoload-dev Tests\... to both tests/ and tests/TestApplication/src/. The skeleton ships without name or description, which is pitfall 1 because the package cannot be published without them.

nodes.label: Files to Physically Rename
nodes.rationale: src/AcmeSyliusExamplePlugin.php and src/DependencyInjection/AcmeSyliusExampleExtension.php become {CompanyName}{PluginName}.php and {CompanyName}{PluginName}Extension.php.

nodes.label: Plugin Naming Convention
nodes.rationale: {CompanyName}\{PluginName} where the plugin name always keeps the Sylius prefix, and the DependencyInjection class must end with Extension.

nodes.label: Recommended Order of Operations
nodes.rationale: Physical file renames, then namespaces, then composer.json, then YAML/XML config, then env files, then docs, then validate - each step's target only resolves once the previous one has landed.

nodes.label: PHP Namespace and Class Name Updates
nodes.norm_label: php namespace and class name updates
nodes.rationale: Covers the plugin class, the Extension, Configuration.php, controllers and any other src/ file. Configuration.php is flagged as 'often missed' precisely because PHPStan excludes it, so nothing fails loudly when it is left behind.

nodes.label: Search and Replace Table
nodes.rationale: Five mechanical substitutions covering the namespace, class name, extension class, Twig namespace and test namespace - ordered longest-first so the shorter patterns cannot corrupt the longer ones.

nodes.label: Rename Troubleshooting
nodes.rationale: Four symptom classes: autoload 'class not found', namespace fatals, the plugin not registering, and test database connection failures - each traced back to a specific unrenamed artifact.

nodes.label: Rename Verification Steps
nodes.rationale: composer validate (a stale lock warning is expected), composer dump-autoload, a repo-wide grep for SyliusExamplePlugin/sylius_example that should only hit documentation, a per-file check, cache clear, and an install smoke test.

nodes.label: AI Development Guides Index
nodes.rationale: CLAUDE.md points at CLEANUP_GUIDE.md, RENAME_GUIDE.md and COMPATIBILITY_GUIDE.md as specialised guides for common plugin development tasks.

nodes.label: Removing Customizations from a Sylius Plugin Skeleton
nodes.norm_label: removing customizations from a sylius plugin skeleton
nodes.rationale: An AI-facing procedure for stripping the skeleton's example/demo code before real plugin work begins.

nodes.label: Plugin Rename Guide
nodes.rationale: Step-by-step procedure for renaming the skeleton's Acme\SyliusExamplePlugin identity to a custom {CompanyName}\{PluginName}. This repository has already executed it - the result is JpmMartin\SyliusShippingCarriersPlugin.

nodes.label: Safe Files to Keep
nodes.rationale: Never delete the main plugin class, src/DependencyInjection/, services.xml or the routing files - empty configuration files are kept because Sylius still requires their presence; only their content is emptied.

nodes.label: Rename Common Pitfalls
nodes.rationale: Missing composer.json name/description, the PHPStan-excluded Configuration.php, unrenamed .env* files, non-snake_case database names, stale service references in tests/Behat/Resources/services.xml, renaming before cleanup, and forgetting composer dump-autoload.

nodes.label: Prerequisite: Run the Cleanup Guide First
nodes.norm_label: prerequisite: run the cleanup guide first
nodes.rationale: Renaming a tree that still contains example code multiplies the references to update and makes stale hits indistinguishable from real ones; a clean slate makes the rename mechanical. Also listed as common pitfall 6.

nodes.label: compose.yml mailhog Service
nodes.rationale: mailhog/mailhog:latest, explicitly annotated 'do not use in production'.

nodes.label: compose.yml mysql Service
nodes.rationale: mysql:8.4 pinned to linux/amd64 with an empty root password, a SHOW databases healthcheck (1s interval, 10 retries) so dependents can gate on service_healthy, and SYS_NICE added to suppress 'mbind: Operation not permitted'.

nodes.label: compose.yml nginx Service
nodes.rationale: ghcr.io/sylius/sylius-nginx:latest depending on php, with no document root or published port until the override supplies them.

nodes.label: APP_SECRET: EDITME Placeholder
nodes.rationale: A deliberate non-secret placeholder in the committed dist file; CLAUDE.md instructs editing it after copying to the gitignored compose.override.yml. APP_ENV defaults to prod via ${ENV:-prod}.

nodes.label: Sylius Messenger Transport DSNs
nodes.rationale: main, main_failed, catalog_promotion_removal and its failed queue all run over doctrine://default (so they land in MySQL), while payment_request and its failure transport are sync:// - payment requests are handled inline rather than queued.

nodes.label: nginx WORKING_DIR Points at the Test Application
nodes.norm_label: nginx working_dir points at the test application
nodes.rationale: WORKING_DIR=/srv/sylius/vendor/sylius/test-application with the repo mounted read-only and port 80 published: the served document root is the vendored test application, not the plugin repo root.

nodes.label: Override nodejs Service
nodes.rationale: node:${NODE_VERSION:-20}-alpine that cds into vendor/sylius/test-application and runs yarn install && yarn build - the containerised equivalent of the frontend-clear composer script. Exists only in the override, so the CI stack builds no assets.

nodes.label: Override php Service (xdebug, volumes, app env)
nodes.norm_label: override php service (xdebug, volumes, app env)
nodes.rationale: Swaps in the 8.3-fixuid-xdebug-alpine image, runs as ${DOCKER_USER:-1000:1000} to keep bind-mounted file ownership sane, gates on mysql service_healthy, mounts the working copy at /srv/sylius, and points Xdebug at host.docker.internal:9003 with PHP_IDE_CONFIG serverName=sylius so PhpStorm path mappings resolve.

nodes.label: Override Named Volumes and Port Publishing
nodes.norm_label: override named volumes and port publishing
nodes.rationale: mysql-data persists the database across recreations, public-media holds uploaded media, and 3306 / 80 / 8025 are published for MySQL, nginx and MailHog respectively. Commented Linux-only bind-mount alternatives are left in place for var/ and public/media.

nodes.label: compose.yml php Service
nodes.rationale: Bare ghcr.io/sylius/sylius-php:8.3-alpine with no volumes, ports or app environment - deliberately CI-shaped, unusable for local development until the override adds them.

nodes.label: Test App Twig Path Registration
nodes.rationale: Registers %kernel.project_dir%/../../../tests/TestApplication/templates with a null namespace. The triple ../ is because kernel.project_dir is the vendored test application, so paths must climb back out of vendor/sylius/test-application to the plugin root.

nodes.label: Composer Scripts (database-reset, frontend-clear, test-app-init)
nodes.rationale: The only scripts defined: database-reset drops/creates/migrates/loads fixtures, frontend-clear runs yarn install and build in the test app then assets:install, test-app-init chains both.

nodes.label: Console Lives at vendor/bin/console
nodes.rationale: Provided by sylius/test-application, not bin/console. The only file in bin/ is show-success.php.

nodes.label: Database Credentials Live in the Test Application .env Files
nodes.norm_label: database credentials live in the test application .env files
nodes.rationale: tests/TestApplication/.env for development and tests/TestApplication/.env.test for testing.

nodes.label: Docker Compose Workflow (No Wrapper)
nodes.rationale: compose.yml alone is the bare CI stack (php, mysql, nginx, mailhog) with no volumes, ports or app environment. compose.override.dist.yml is what makes it usable locally; copy it to the gitignored compose.override.yml and edit APP_SECRET before use.

nodes.label: KERNEL_CLASS Is the Test Application Kernel
nodes.norm_label: kernel_class is the test application kernel
nodes.rationale: Sylius/TestApplication/Kernel is declared twice - in phpunit.xml.dist and under FriendsOfBehat SymfonyExtension in behat.yml.dist. The kernel is the test application's, never one of this plugin's.

nodes.label: sylius/test-application Host
nodes.rationale: Hosts the plugin in isolation and also supplies vendor/bin/console and the public dir via extra.public-dir. Assets are built through its yarn build (Webpack Encore); extra.symfony.require pins ^7.4.

nodes.label: tests/bootstrap.php Environment Bootstrap
nodes.rationale: Loads the Composer autoloader, forces APP_ENV=test, then delegates to the test application's config/bootstrap.php, which boots Dotenv from the test application and from the plugin's tests/TestApplication/.env. Setting APP_ENV before that delegation is precisely what makes .env.test win.

nodes.label: Docker 'make ecs' / 'make phpstan' Instructions
nodes.rationale: Inherited skeleton instruction. These targets do not exist in this repository - CLAUDE.md states there is no Makefile at all, so this guidance is dead on arrival here.

nodes.label: Step 5: Post-Cleanup Verification
nodes.rationale: Clear var/cache, grep config/ for leftover twig_hooks/greeting/example references, then run phpstan analyse -c phpstan.neon -l max src/ and ecs check.

nodes.label: Docker Setup via make init / make database-init / make load-fixtures
nodes.norm_label: docker setup via make init / make database-init / make load-fixtures
nodes.rationale: Inherited skeleton instruction promising an app at http://localhost. No Makefile exists in this repository, so all three targets fail; CLAUDE.md's Docker section replaces them with direct docker compose invocations.

nodes.label: Opening Sylius With the Plugin (test vs dev env)
nodes.norm_label: opening sylius with the plugin (test vs dev env)
nodes.rationale: Prefixing both sylius:fixtures:load and symfony server:start with APP_ENV=test keeps fixtures and server on the same database as the Behat suite.

nodes.label: Quickstart Installation
nodes.rationale: composer create-project sylius/plugin-skeleton ProjectName as the entry point.

nodes.label: Traditional Setup Sequence
nodes.rationale: yarn install and yarn build inside vendor/sylius/test-application, then assets:install, doctrine:database:create, migrations:migrate -n and optional sylius:fixtures:load -n, all through vendor/bin/console; database credentials must first be set in tests/TestApplication/.env and .env.test. Server via symfony server:ca:install and server:start -d on https://localhost:8000.

nodes.label: Environment File Updates
nodes.rationale: DATABASE_URL, CONFIGS_TO_IMPORT and ROUTES_TO_IMPORT in tests/TestApplication/.env and .env.test all embed the plugin name; database names use snake_case. Note the guide's ROUTES_TO_IMPORT example points at config/shop_routing.yaml while this repo splits routes into config/routes/{admin,shop}.yaml.

nodes.label: Twig Namespace @{CompanyName}{PluginName}
nodes.rationale: The Twig namespace is the @-prefixed full plugin class name, so it must change in lockstep with the class rename and in every twig_hooks yaml and test config that references it.

nodes.label: Plugin Skeleton README
nodes.rationale: Still the unmodified sylius/plugin-skeleton README - it describes the skeleton ('Skeleton for starting Sylius plugins', composer create-project sylius/plugin-skeleton), not the UPS/FedEx shipping plugin this repository has become.

nodes.label: Sylius Plugin Development Guide (docs.sylius.com)
nodes.rationale: External citation: docs.sylius.com plugins-development-guide, including its Test Application page.

nodes.label: No Makefile in This Repository
nodes.rationale: Any 'make <target>' instruction found in a guide, a README or an older revision of CLAUDE.md does not work here. Either use the documented commands or add a Makefile first.

nodes.label: Conventional Commit Type Vocabulary
nodes.rationale: Only feat and fix are mandated by the spec; the rest is the Angular-derived set (docs - not doc - refactor, perf, test, build, ci, chore, style, revert). Do not invent new types; style is never mixed with another type.

nodes.label: context7 MCP Server
nodes.rationale: May arrive as a marketplace plugin or a project-scoped .mcp.json server; this repo declares neither and relies on the developer's own configuration. Its version pinning behaviour is explicitly marked unverified, so a context7 answer may never be cited as version-verified.

nodes.label: Declared Constraints: php ^8.2 and sylius/sylius ^2.2
nodes.rationale: The only two version facts stable enough to record in CLAUDE.md; everything else must be derived from composer.lock at the moment of asking.

nodes.label: Rule 4: Conventional Commits v1.0.0
nodes.rationale: Message shape is <type>[scope][!]: <description> with optional body and footers.

nodes.label: SDD Phase 4: Implement
nodes.rationale: One task at a time; after each, run tests, tick the box in tasks.md and reference the task number in the commit. If implementation reveals the spec is wrong, stop and amend the spec - never diverge silently.

nodes.label: SDD Phase 2: Plan
nodes.rationale: plan.md covers HOW. Every architectural option must be backed by pinned-version docs or vendor/ source and the plan must record what was checked; a plan containing an unverified claim about Sylius, UPS or FedEx behaviour is a defective plan.

nodes.label: SDD Phase 1: Specify
nodes.rationale: specs/<NNN>-<slug>/spec.md covers WHAT and WHY with zero implementation detail; acceptance criteria must be verifiable ('returns 404 when X', not 'handles errors properly'). Hard approval gate before Plan.

nodes.label: SDD Phase 3: Tasks
nodes.rationale: The approval gate here is explicitly non-optional: Implement is the first phase that writes code, so this is the last point at which a wrong decomposition is still cheap to fix.

nodes.label: SDD Phase 5: Verify
nodes.rationale: Before declaring anything done, walk every acceptance criterion in spec.md and confirm each passes.

nodes.label: Source Consultation Precedence Order
nodes.rationale: Four ordered sources, stop at the first that settles the question: vendor/ source and config, then debug:*/config:dump-reference for wiring, then context7 for intent, then version-pinned official docs.

nodes.label: Resolved Version Derivation Command
nodes.rationale: A one-second php -r over composer.lock prints every resolved package, so a hardcoded version table would be pure liability. Never query 'latest' and never trust a version written in CLAUDE.md.

nodes.label: Multi-Version Composer Constraints
nodes.rationale: php ^8.1 as the cross-version floor, sylius/sylius ^1.14 || ^2.0 || ^2.1 with the || operator, and prefer-stable: true. Conflicts with the php ^8.2 / sylius ^2.2 constraints CLAUDE.md records as this package's declared floor.

nodes.label: Testing Across Sylius Versions
nodes.rationale: Re-require a pinned ~1.14.0 / ~2.0.0 / ~2.1.0 then run phpunit, phpspec and behat. Note phpspec run is listed although this repo's documented toolchain has no phpspec.

nodes.label: AGENTS.md Delegation to CLAUDE.md
nodes.rationale: AGENTS.md holds no rules of its own; it is a one-line redirect so agent tooling that looks for AGENTS.md lands on the single authoritative CLAUDE.md instead of a second, drifting copy.

nodes.label: Sylius Multi-Version Compatibility (1.14 / 2.0 / 2.1)
nodes.rationale: Inherited skeleton guide targeting Sylius 1.14.x, 2.0.x and 2.1.x. This plugin's own declared constraint is sylius/sylius ^2.2, so the guide describes a support matrix the package does not currently claim.

nodes.label: composer.lock Is Gitignored
nodes.rationale: Correct for a distributed library, but it means a fresh clone has no lock, so composer install behaves like composer update and resolves different versions than whoever wrote any version table got. Drift is the guaranteed outcome, not a risk.

nodes.label: Gap: PHPStan Pinned to ^1.12
nodes.rationale: It prints an upgrade notice on every run. Moving to ^2.2 is a build: change with its own error surface, not a bump to do in passing.

nodes.label: Gap: 4 PHPStan Level-Max Errors in Skeleton Code
nodes.norm_label: gap: 4 phpstan level-max errors in skeleton code
nodes.rationale: Missing iterable value types in three files plus one string|null passed to str_starts_with. Left unfixed on purpose: fixing them is a fix:/refactor: commit, not part of adding configuration.

nodes.label: Gap: No Sylius 2.x Rector Upgrade Set Exists
nodes.norm_label: gap: no sylius 2.x rector upgrade set exists
nodes.rationale: rector/rector 1.2.10 has no Symfony set past SYMFONY_71 while the stack resolves Symfony 7.4, and sylius/sylius-rector 2.0 ships only plus/ and price-history/ sets. Do not add a SyliusSetList entry for 2.x - it does not exist.

nodes.label: How We Work Here
nodes.rationale: Durable rules and non-obvious facts only. Mutable state (whether a commit exists, today's branch) is banned because a stale note reads as verified truth and is worse than no note; every fact is stated once in its topical section.

nodes.label: Rule 1: Read the Real Source Before Saying Anything
nodes.norm_label: rule 1: read the real source before saying anything
nodes.rationale: In a shipping carrier plugin practically every decision lands on Symfony, Sylius, Doctrine, UPS or FedEx, so the obligation is unconditional and fires even when no library is named. Silence about having checked is not acceptable: the reader must be able to distinguish a verified answer from an unverified one.

nodes.label: Rule 2: Assume Nothing
nodes.rationale: If the corpus does not settle a point, mark it unsettled rather than forcing a plausible answer into the gap. 'The docs don't specify this; here are the two readings' is the preferred answer.

nodes.label: Rule 3: Spec-Driven Development
nodes.rationale: The spec is the source of truth and code serves it. Applies to new features, endpoints, integrations, schema changes, or anything touching 3+ files; explicitly does not apply to typos, one-line fixes, dependency bumps or formatting.

nodes.label: SemVer Is Binding for This Package
nodes.norm_label: semver is binding for this package
nodes.rationale: Consumers install with a caret constraint, so the commit type is a promise about the next release number: fix->PATCH, feat->MINOR, !/BREAKING CHANGE->MAJOR. Breaking here means a public interface, service id or DI tag another plugin could rely on, a non-backward-compatible schema change, or a change to already-stored shipping method / carrier config keys. The mapping assumes a 1.0.0+ line: under SemVer 2.0.0 section 4 a 0.y.z line makes no promise at all, and extra.branch-alias.dev-master is 2.0-dev so the table applies from the first tag.

nodes.label: specs/ Is Deliberately Not Published
nodes.rationale: SDD artifacts live only in the author's working copy: the 'Refs: specs/...' commit footer resolves on that machine and nowhere else, and the specs are not backed up by the repository. Stated as a decision, not an oversight - do not 'fix' it by committing specs/.

nodes.label: vendor/ Outranks Every Other Source
nodes.rationale: vendor/ is the exact pinned code that actually executes, and it is local and free to read. context7 indexes the upstream repo, not the pinned tree, so when the two disagree vendor/ wins.

nodes.label: Cross-Version Best Practices
nodes.rationale: Use the most conservative constraint that works everywhere, test against every supported version before release, document version-specific features, and automate the matrix in CI.

nodes.label: Plugin Shop Routing Placeholder
nodes.rationale: Comment-only counterpart to admin.yaml, imported by the test application under the jpm_martin_sylius_shipping_carriers_shop key.

nodes.label: Commented Context Service Id Template
nodes.rationale: The commented example wires a suite to jpm_martin_sylius_shipping_carriers.context.ui.admin.something filtered by a @managing_something tag - contexts are referenced by container service id, not class name, which is why services.xml registration is mandatory.

nodes.label: Explicitly Empty Behat Default Suites
nodes.rationale: 'default: suites: {}' is deliberate: with no suites configured at all, Behat falls back to an implicit default suite bound to a FeatureContext class this plugin does not have, and every run dies before it starts. The explicit empty mapping keeps vendor/bin/behat green until the first real suite lands.

nodes.label: Test App Imports services_test.php
nodes.rationale: The hop that pulls tests/Behat/Resources/services.xml into the container, which is what makes Behat contexts and page objects resolvable by service id.

nodes.label: Test App Shop Route Import
nodes.rationale: Key jpm_martin_sylius_shipping_carriers_shop importing '@JpmMartinSyliusShippingCarriersPlugin/config/routes/shop.yaml'.

nodes.label: Behat Suite and Context Wiring
nodes.rationale: Suites are not defined in behat.yml.dist; it imports tests/Behat/Resources/suites.yml. Contexts and pages are wired as services in tests/Behat/Resources/services.xml, which the kernel picks up through tests/TestApplication/config/services_test.php.

nodes.label: etc/build Must Exist
nodes.rationale: FriendsOfBehat MinkDebugExtension writes screenshots and logs there; the directory is kept in git by etc/build/.gitignore.

nodes.label: Testing and Code Quality Toolchain
nodes.rationale: Every tool is configured at the repo root (phpunit.xml.dist, behat.yml.dist, phpstan.neon, ecs.php, rector.php), so paths and levels live in those files and the commands deliberately take no flags.

nodes.label: Test Scaffolding Is Inherited Demo Material
nodes.norm_label: test scaffolding is inherited demo material
nodes.rationale: tests/{Unit,Integration,Functional} hold only .gitignore placeholders, and tests/Behat/{Context,Page,Resources} plus the three features/*.feature files are skeleton demo material, not plugin coverage.

nodes.label: Greeting Feature Removal Pattern
nodes.rationale: The concrete skeleton instance: GreetingController.php, the acme_sylius_example_static_welcome / dynamic_welcome routes, templates/shop/greeting/, assets/shop/js/greetings.js and the *greeting* feature and Welcome page files.

nodes.label: Behat JS Scenarios Need Headless Chrome on 9222
nodes.norm_label: behat js scenarios need headless chrome on 9222
nodes.rationale: google-chrome-stable with --headless --remote-debugging-port=9222, symfony server:ca:install once, and APP_ENV=test symfony server:start --port=8080 --daemon before behat --strict --tags='@javascript,@mink:chromedriver'.

nodes.label: Running Plugin Tests
nodes.rationale: phpunit; behat --strict with tag filters excluding or selecting @javascript and @mink:chromedriver; phpstan analyse -c phpstan.neon -l max src/; ecs check. CLAUDE.md notes the flags are redundant because every tool is configured at the repo root.

nodes.label: Gap: Feature File Belonging to No Behat Suite
nodes.norm_label: gap: feature file belonging to no behat suite
nodes.rationale: features/running_a_sylius_feature.feature is tagged @managing_channels while suites.yml is described as defining only a greeting_customer suite, so the feature belongs to no suite and never runs. NOTE: the actual tests/Behat/Resources/suites.yml now declares 'suites: {}', so this note's premise is stale even though its conclusion (the feature never runs) still holds.

nodes.label: page-object-extension Is a Class Library, Not a Behat Extension
nodes.norm_label: page-object-extension is a class library, not a behat extension
nodes.rationale: It ships no ServiceContainer, so listing it under extensions: breaks the run. Its SymfonyPage is simply extended by the page objects.

nodes.label: Configuration TreeBuilder Alias Must Be snake_case
nodes.norm_label: configuration treebuilder alias must be snake_case
nodes.rationale: new TreeBuilder('{company_name_snake}_{plugin_name_snake}') must match the extension alias, and the guide says to drop the trailing _plugin suffix. Here that alias is jpm_martin_sylius_shipping_carriers.

Test Application to Plugin Configuration Import Chain
